summary.headline: Planetary Configurations and Oppositions
summary.text: Astrological judgments on planetary configurations: angular planets witnessed by benefics or malefics, Sun and Moon with Saturn, Mars, and Jupiter, Mercury-Venus and Moon-Venus squares, and Moon-Mercury squares. The opposition section treats Saturn opposed to Jupiter or Mars, including late achievement, enmity, bodily troubles, shipwreck, and floods.
